CapabilityCredential.replay: credential_id and signed_object_hash are unique; request replay is handled separately
CapabilityCredential.null_semantics: parent_credential_id and parent_credential_hash are required null

DelegationCredential.hash_rule: SM3(Canonical(signed_object)); child binds parent signed-object hash
DelegationCredential.freshness: child interval is contained in parent interval and includes gateway_now
DelegationCredential.null_semantics: parent_credential_id and parent_credential_hash are required non-null

BusinessAction.verifier: Business Action Registry and Admission Engine
BusinessAction.hash_rule: action_scope_key uses the tool-specific domain and canonical trusted scope
BusinessAction.freshness: bound to current tenant and task lifecycle
BusinessAction.replay: UNIQUE(action_scope_key) resolves retries to one business_action_id

RequestEnvelope.replay: request_id is unique and every network retry uses a new request_id
RequestEnvelope.null_semantics: business_action_id is required null for read-only and required non-null for side effects

RequestContext.replay: execution_id is allocated after context establishment; request_id remains unique
RequestContext.null_semantics: business_action_id follows read-only versus side-effect semantics

HolderProof.hash_rule: signature covers chain hash, task, tool version, parameter hash, request, issued_at, and business action
HolderProof.freshness: bound issued_at is evaluated using gateway time
HolderProof.null_semantics: business_action_id is required null only for read-only or controlled retrieval

ValidatedToolCommand.freshness: not independently reusable outside its admitted execution
ValidatedToolCommand.null_semantics: business action and idempotency are null only for read-only tools

GatewayExecutionEnvelope.replay: execution_attempt_id has a database UNIQUE constraint at the tool boundary
GatewayExecutionEnvelope.null_semantics: business action and idempotency are null only for read-only tools

ResultRetrievalRequest.hash_rule: HolderProof binds the retrieval target through canonical parameters
ResultRetrievalRequest.replay: retrieval request_id is unique and creates no execution, reserve, action, or effect
ResultRetrievalRequest.null_semantics: exactly one of execution_id or receipt_id is non-null

ExecutionReceipt.verifier: Client, Audit Verifier, and independent evaluator
ExecutionReceipt.freshness: receipt time records evidence issuance and never changes the prior business decision
ExecutionReceipt.replay: receipt_id is unique and retrieval returns the existing signed object
ExecutionReceipt.null_semantics: DENY and read-only receipts require null effect fields as defined by schema

RejectedAuditEvent.hash_rule: raw_request_hash is SM3(raw bytes); event is incorporated into AuditEvent hash chain
RejectedAuditEvent.replay: each transport rejection creates one outbox event ID; no execution is created
RejectedAuditEvent.null_semantics: raw request content is absent by design

AuditEvent.replay: outbox_event_id and event_sequence are unique; append head is row-locked
AuditEvent.null_semantics: execution_id may be null only for RAW_REQUEST_REJECTED

AuditCheckpoint.verifier: Independent Audit Service and Audit Verifier
AuditCheckpoint.hash_rule: signature binds sequence, latest event sequence, hash, and timestamp
AuditCheckpoint.replay: checkpoint_sequence, latest_event_sequence, and latest_event_hash are unique in independent storage
